project.name: Bitburner agent
project.summary: Autonomous Bitburner agent: in-game Netscript scripts (game/) play the game around the clock, a Node bridge/hosted server (server/, bb CLI) syncs files, takes save backups, runs check-ins and watchdogs, and an AI agent supervises through it. Serves the owner (Boyce), who only reads check-in reports.

claude_review.focus:
AGENTS.md "Owner's standing rules" are hard requirements. game/ mirrors the in-game home server (Netscript 2 JS run by the game), server/ is the Node bridge + hosted container, deploy/ + Dockerfile build the Railway image.
Correctness bugs that could stall the game loop, waste in-game money or RAM, or crash the server/watchdog.
Standing-rule violations: aug buy order, NeuroFlux last, never deleting saves, /data/state or backups, never changing game options.
Tokens/webhooks leaking into logs, Discord, commits or responses; auth bypass on /api/*.
Missing tests for server/ changes.
